comparison.objective: Remove a worn conveyor roller and install a replacement, versus adjust and validate a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual level lifting and simultaneous axle-end slot insertion versus tool alignment, counterholding, fine rotation, locking, and repeated impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Old roller on the mat and new roller seated in slots; candidate requires a locked setting producing two safe, repeatable stops.
comparison.reason: Component replacement with dual-end alignment differs materially from in-place dynamic tuning and retention verification.
